description: Source code for the 'lib.rs' module of the SQLPage web server project, defining modules, constants, and the AppState struct with initialization logic.

classes.name: AppState
classes.description: Holds application state including database connection, templates, cache, filesystem, configuration, and optional OIDC state.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Asynchronously initializes AppState with configuration, setting up database, templates, cache, filesystem, and OIDC state.

methods.name: init_with_db
methods.description: Asynchronously initializes AppState with provided database, setting up templates, cache, filesystem, and OIDC state.
